Name: Nova Avatar
Information:
**Nova Avatar**

Within the core of each burning star is a gateway to the Plane of Positive Energy, and from those gates sometimes flows embodiments of the plane itself, in the form of nova avatars. These are not necessarily natives to the Plane of Positive Energy, but rather are flickers of starlight that the planes grant animation and will. Nova avatars typically reside within stars themselves, defending them from threats, but when one disappears (such as through a supernova), its inhabitants may be thrown across the universe in a confused rage.

Information Sections.Text:
Living sparks, born from pure light...”

traits.name: Body of Illumination
traits.description: The elemental projects bright sunlight 30 feet in every direction, then dim light 30 feet beyond that. Creatures cannot benefit from being invisible within the elemental’s bright light, where they are made plainly visible. Similarly, creatures in the Ethereal Plane in this range are visible and treated as though they are in the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Vitality Slicer
traits.description: When the elemental deals damage to a creature with temporary hit points, the damage that reduces their temporary hit points is doubled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two Sunlight Fist attacks.

actions.name: Sunlight Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) radiant damage. The first time each creature is hit by this attack each turn, they must succeed a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of the elemental’s next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Cancerous Restoration (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.description: The elemental chooses one creature it can see within 60 feet, and directs unchecked positive energy toward them. That target must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, their maximum hit points are reduced by 3d8 until they complete a Long Rest, and the elemental gains twice that many temporary hit points.
